synopsis: ISO 34501:2022 provides vocabulary for scenario-based evaluation within the road-vehicle ISO 3450x scenario standards [f15313, f15312]. Chapter 9 treats ISO 34501–34505 as transferable methodological templates for off-road validation, while stressing that their content addresses Level 3 and higher road automated-driving systems rather than off-road compliance [f6642, f7182, f15320]. The chapter's scenario catalog uses functional, logical and concrete scenarios, a three-level abstraction originating in the German PEGASUS project and adopted into ISO 34501–34505 [f6735, f13258, f15322]. The glossary also states that the ISO 3450x series, ISO/PAS 34506 and ISO/TS 5083 establish no physical-to-virtual testing ratio, leaving that allocation unspecified by these standards [f15321].

relations.note: Both identify PEGASUS origins and the same three scenario levels adopted by ISO 3450x.
